title: Dual hypercontractive bound
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $T$ be an operator on real-valued functions on the sign cube $\{-1,1\}^n$. Suppose $T$ is self-adjoint for the uniform inner product and satisfies $\|Tf\|_4\le\|f\|_2$ for every function $f$. Then, for every function $g$, $\|Tg\|_2\le\|g\|_{4/3}$, with all norms taken under the uniform probability measure on the cube.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is self-adjoint for the uniform inner product
